debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-i-l-e-d f-a-l-s-e i-n-j-u-r-y c-l-a-i-m d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s a-n-d l-e-f-t f-r-a-u-d-u-l-e-n-t t-i-m-e s-t-a-m-p s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n o-f a-c-t-u-a-l i-n-j-u-r-y i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t.
2) t-h-e y w-o-r-k-e-d w-i-t-h t-o m-b-u-t-t-o-n c-o-w-o-r-k-e-r-s t-o r-e-h-e-a-r-s-e t-h-e i-n-j-u-r-y s-t-o-r-y l-e-a-v-i-n-g c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-d d-e-p-o-s-i-t-i-o-n s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t w-i-t-n-e-s s v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
3) t-h-e y m-o-d-i-f-i-e-d m-e-d-i-c-a-l r-e-c-o-r-d s t-o m-i-s-r-e-p-r-e-s-e-n-t s-y-m-p-t-o-m s a-n-d l-e-f-t i-n-c-o-n-s-i-s-t-e-n-t h-e-a-l-t-h f-i-l-e s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g o-r-i-g-i-n-a-l s-o-u-r-c d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t r-e-c-o-n-c-i-l-i-a-t-i-o-n.
4) t-h-e y g-u-i-d-e-d t-h-e p-h-y-s-i-c-i-a n t-o r-e-c-o-r-d s-u-p-p-o-r-t-i-n-g d-i-a-g-n-o-s-e s a-n-d l-e-f-t a-l-t-e-r-e-d m-e-d-i-c-a-l n-o-t-e s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d d-i-a-g-n-o-s-t-i-c v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n.
5) t-h-e y s-t-r-u-c-t-u-r-e-d t-h-e c-l-a-i m f-o-r i-n-s-u-r-e r i-n-v-e-s-t-i-g-a-t-i-o n r-e-s-i-s-t-a-n c-e a-n-d l-e-f-t s-h-i-e-l-d-e-d c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-m-e-n-t s.
6) t-h-e y d-e-n-i-e-d r-e-p-o-r-t-i-n g t-h-e a-c-t-u-a l i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t d-e-t-a-i-l-s a-n-d l-e-f-t m-i-s-r-e-p-r-e-s-e-n-t-a-t-i-o-n s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g l-e-g-a l o-b-l-i-g-a-t-i-o-n s f-o-r t-r-u-t-h-f-u-l r-e-p-o-r-t-i-n-g.
